facts.business: Sakthi Sugars Limited is engaged in the manufacture of sugar, industrial alcohol, power generation, and by-products such as molasses, bagasse, and bio-earth, along with trading of fertilizers and chemicals.

segments.name: By-products (Molasses, Bagasse, Bio-earth, CO2, Fusel oil, Ash)

auditor.name: P N RAGHAVENDRA RAO & Co
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Prior approval of shareholders by way of Special Resolution under Regulation 17(1A) of Listing Regulations was not obtained prior to appointment of a Non-Executive Independent Director aged over 75 years; approval subsequently obtained at General Meeting.

key_risks: Weather-related uncertainties and dependence on monsoon rainfall for sugarcane cultivation
